home.experience: I have a degree in Graphic Design since 2011, with over a decade of experience in visual creation and 3D modeling. I have technical expertise in Maya, ZBrush, Photoshop, KeyShot, and Substance 3D Painter, tools I use to turn ideas into impactful images, whether in product projects, animation, architectural visualization, or motion design.
home.techSkills: Beyond design, I am passionate about technology and programming, focusing on React JS and Python. This combination allows me to integrate art and logic, creating interactive and functional visual solutions.
home.goals: I am looking for opportunities in 3D design, tech art, digital visualization, and projects that value creativity, technique, and innovation. Let's connect!

resume.title: Resume
resume.professionalSummary: I am a graphic designer graduated from Universidade Paulista (UNIP) in 2011, with solid experience in 3D modeling, animation, and visual design. I began my career at Lubrin, an engineering company, creating 3D projects of engines, reducers, and technical components. Additionally, I developed graphic materials such as flyers and folders, managed the company website, and edited videos and images. After this experience, I worked as a freelancer at IzotonicStudios game development studio, contributing with 3D modeling, texturing, and 2D/3D animations for characters and environments. I also work as a designer at MentalPlus®, responsible for the homonymous neuropsychology app, where I model and animate the mascot Dr. Brainy, and maintain the company website. I am passionate about technology and innovation, always seeking constant updates in new tools and techniques. I have a collaborative profile, proactive in decisions, objective, determined, and extremely detail-oriented in my creative processes.
